label: Airwallex sandbox · test money
simulated: The approver is a labelled virtual test passkey ("money-loop virtual test passkey (no person's Face ID)", src/redteam/authenticator.ts), enrolled as the only passkey of the run's own fresh ledger. Its signatures go through the same verification as a phone's (WebAuthn assertion over the exact terms hash); no person's Face ID was used.

The CHF payable (AGZ-1126, "Alpenglas Zuerich AG (test supplier)") is a test invoice entered in the run's ledger: no supplier sent it, and it is not paid by this run. The balances, the rates, the quote and the conversion are the sandbox's own (test money).
The change after signing (buy_amount 100.00 to 100.01 in the stored terms) is made by the run in its own ledger, as someone with write access to the ledger would; the refused proposal is then closed.

passes.note: A fresh ledger of its own. The sandbox holds no CHF, so a test payable of CHF 100.00 due in 10 days makes the forecast fall CHF 100.00 short; the CFO's threshold is EUR 50.00. Before the runs, 6 read-only calls looked at the sandbox (two probes, logins included: the balances twice, the beneficiaries and the Global Accounts); none moved money or changed anything, and they are not in this record's call table. The three runs (19:53 to 19:54 UTC) ran one after the other on the code committed as `9abc1b24b`. The code that ran includes the review fixes of 26 Nov: the FX executor judges the floor on free money under the payout lock and holds the signed maximum, and checks the stop, pause and the agent's identity again right before the create; a payment reference names an invoice only as a whole word.

steps.outcome: 4 currencies with money available: CNY 10000000.00, EUR 9622616.14, GBP 10001085.50, USD 9981754.40; CHF available 0.00

steps.title: The 13-week forecast from the real balances and the ledger; the advisor's exposure and suggestion from Airwallex's indicative rates (GET /fx/rates/current, which moves nothing)
steps.expect: one suggestion: buy CHF 100.00 with EUR, at or above the threshold
steps.outcome: CHF lowest -100.00 in week 2, short 100.00; suggested: buy CHF 100.00 with at most EUR 111.49 (indicative 110.38 at 0.905922, about EUR 110.38 against the threshold EUR 50.00); 4 rates read

suggestion.reason: The forecast has CHF at CHF -100.00 in week 2, CHF 100.00 under its floor of CHF 0.00; buying it with EUR (about EUR 110.38, at most EUR 111.49) keeps EUR above its own floor.

steps.title: A conversion proposal filed and signed with the passkey; its stored terms then changed (buy_amount 100.00 to 100.01) and the executor started

steps.title: The same suggestion filed again and signed with the passkey
